description: This PHP source file defines the 'Header' class within the Opencart\Install\Controller\Common namespace. The class extends a base Controller and provides an 'index' method that loads language, gathers document data (like title, description, links, styles, scripts), loads a language controller, and returns a view with this data, serving as the controller for rendering the header component during installation.
